Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via deserialization of untrusted user-supplied data
Exploitation of lack of proper validation of user-supplied data leading to code execution
Impacted Systems: HPE Systems Insight Manager (SIM) software Windows version
Attack Vector: User-supplied data deserialization vulnerability in HPE SIM
Federated Search and Federated CMS Configuration features in HPE SIM
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of simsearch.war file in C:\Program Files\HP\Systems Insight Manager\jboss\server\hpsim\deploy\
Access to HPE SIM web page at https://SIM_IP:50000
Use of mxtool command with multi-cms-search.xml
